column1: # The one label -> setting mapping. run-all.sh reads it; docs/recipes/large-text.md and the Playwright
# example are tested against it. Columns (tab-separated): label, platform (ios, android, web), value: iOS
# "xcrun simctl ui <udid> content_size <value>", Android "adb shell settings put system font_scale <value>",
# web page zoom. A label with no row for a platform has no setting there.
